missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Телевизор' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Этот' is the agreeing masculine demonstrative, and 'большой' describes its size.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Телевизор' is the accusative direct object of 'купил'. Because it is an inanimate masculine noun, the accusative matches the nominative form. 'Новый' agrees in masculine.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Телевизора' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that something is missing. The ending -а is the standard masculine genitive singular.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Телевизору' takes the dative case after 'к', showing movement toward the object. The ending -у marks the masculine dative singular.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Телевизором' takes the instrumental after 'перед', showing position in front of something. The ending -ом is the masculine instrumental singular.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Телевизоре' takes the prepositional after 'на' to show where the remote lies. The ending -е marks the masculine prepositional singular.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Телевизоры' is the accusative plural object of 'продают'. As an inanimate noun, the plural accusative matches the nominative plural ending -ы.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Телевизор' is the accusative direct object of 'смотрят', the everyday way to say watch TV. 'Каждый вечер' adds frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Телевизора' takes the genitive to show whose price it is. 'Этого' agrees in the masculine genitive, linking the price to the set.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Телевизора' takes the genitive after 'без' to express absence. The ending -а marks the masculine genitive singular.
